description: Reads rows from ONE sheet the user owns. Returns each exact row id plus non-empty cell values with their visible column labels and stable column ids. Reads up to 25 rows at a time with offset/limit, or known rowIds directly; filters and search read only the rows that pass them, as the sheet's Filtrar and Buscar do (matchingRows says how many). For a people sheet, contactColumns lists LinkedIn, E-mail and Telefone as the app shows them, each with the column that holds it and the column id that reveals it. Read-only and free. Each row comes with kind ("person", or "company" for a company without a person yet) and company (its id, name, domain and CNPJ, the same for every person of that company).

filters.description: Only the rows that pass every filter, as the sheet's Filtrar does.

field.description: uf, size (porte), cnae, role (cargo), employees (number range), signal (signal type), campaign, contact, import_miss, or column:<columnId> (the column ids the sheet rows list).

op.description: in: any of values (contact: all of them); contains / not_contains / is: text; empty / not_empty; between: min and/or max.

values.description: For in. campaign: none, no_active, active, paused, draft, ended or id:<campaignId>. contact: email, phone, linkedin, no_email, no_phone, no_linkedin.

limit.description: Rows to return when rowIds is omitted. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset when rowIds is omitted. Defaults to 0.

rowIds.description: Optionally read only these exact row ids, preserving this order.

search.description: Only the rows whose name, company, role or e-mail hold this text.

name: get_sheet_rows
